headline: GPs to receive £40m to support patients with frailty, heart disease and COPD this winter
dek: Pulse Today reports that GPs will receive £40m this winter to support patients with frailty, heart disease and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
body:
GPs are to receive £40m to support patients with frailty, heart disease and COPD this winter, according to a report published by Pulse Today on 9 November 2026.

The item names three patient groups that the funding is intended to support: people with frailty, people with heart disease and people with COPD.

The text available for this article does not set out how the money will be distributed, who is providing it, or what practices will be expected to do with it. Further detail was not included in the source.
key_quote: GPs to get £40m to support patients with frailty, heart disease and COPD this winter
